profile_text.body:
Meta describes itself as a builder of AI models and tools for developers. Its site at llama.com promotes access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API, with resources to get started. The company says its model is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It offers a quick start in under five minutes using an OpenAI SDK compatible client pointed at Meta Model API, search grounding that gives a model live access to the web, and Muse Image on Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing with anchored composition for consistent edits.

The company's product catalog includes Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family often self-hosted, in the Chat & General LLMs category. The company's website also names Muse Spark, Muse Code, Meta Model API, and Muse Image. MCP servers associated with Meta include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as having 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, and co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation.

Meta is a public company, ticker META, CIK 0001326801, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA. Its last revenue form is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting $200,966,000,000. The company is a defendant in three cases: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. The company has 281 California law exposure entries.
